spec.semantics_python:
def sem(rs1, rs2, state):
    # custom-0, funct3=0x0, funct7[1:0]=k : FMAC  acc[k] += rs1 * rs2 ; rd = acc[k]
    # Plugin ISS truyen funct7[1:0] vao state['imm_acc'].
    k = state.get('imm_acc', 0) & 3
    a = rs1 & 0xFFFFFFFF
    b = rs2 & 0xFFFFFFFF
    p = (a * b) & 0xFFFFFFFF          # 32 bit thap: giong nhau cho co dau va khong dau
    acc = state.setdefault('macc', [0, 0, 0, 0])
    acc[k] = (acc[k] + p) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    state['macc'] = acc
    return acc[k], state

Bien tich luy chuyen tu thanh ghi kien truc sang acc[k], giai phong 1 thanh ghi moi chuoi tich luy — quan trong vi static.json layers.conv2.loops[1].n_regs_free = 3. Khoi tao acc[k] = 0 va doc ket qua ra bang lenh ACCRD (cung opcode 0x0b, funct3=0x2, funct7[1:0]=k) tai dau/cuoi moi chuoi tich luy, nen chi phi khoi tao/doc la O(so output), khong phai O(so MAC).

spec.semantics_python:
def sem(rs1, rs2, state):
    # custom-0, funct3=0x3 : LMAC   acc[k] += mem8(rs1) * rs2 ; rd = acc[k]
    # rs1 = dia chi byte cua phan tu kich hoat int8
    # rs2 = trong so int8 da mo rong dau, dang san trong thanh ghi
    f7 = state.get('imm_acc', 0)
    k = f7 & 3
    signed_mem = (f7 >> 2) & 1
    addr = rs1 & 0xFFFFFFFF
    v = state['mem'][addr] & 0xFF                 # mot truy cap bo nho duy nhat
    if signed_mem and (v & 0x80):
        v = (v - 256) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    p = (v * (rs2 & 0xFFFFFFFF)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    acc = state.setdefault('macc', [0, 0, 0, 0])
    acc[k] = (acc[k] + p) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    state['macc'] = acc
    return acc[k], state

spec.semantics_python:
def sem(rs1, rs2, state):
    # custom-0, funct3=0x1 : SDOT4  acc[k] += sum_{i=0..3} lane_i(rs1) * lane_i(rs2)
    f7 = state.get('imm_acc', 0)
    k = f7 & 3
    rs1_unsigned = (f7 >> 2) & 1
    s = 0
    for i in range(4):
        a = (rs1 >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF
        b = (rs2 >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF
        if (not rs1_unsigned) and (a & 0x80):
            a -= 256
        if b & 0x80:
            b -= 256
        s += a * b
    acc = state.setdefault('macc', [0, 0, 0, 0])
    acc[k] = (acc[k] + s) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    state['macc'] = acc
    return acc[k], state

Yeu cau tien quyet: con tro kich hoat va trong so phai thang hang 4 byte — bo dem kernel va mang dac trung sang bien gioi 4 byte trong bo nho. spec.semantics_python:
def sem(rs1, rs2, state):
    # custom-1 : khoi MAC 4 nhom x 4 lan int8
    #   funct3=0x1 WLOAD  w[g] = rs1 (4 trong so int8 goi trong 1 tu)
    #   funct3=0x0 MACQ   voi moi g: accq[g] += dot4(rs1, w[g])   (rs1 = 4 kich hoat int8)
    #   funct3=0x2 ACCRD  rd = accq[g] ; accq[g] = 0
    f3 = state.get('imm_funct3', 0x0)
    g = state.get('imm_acc', 0) & 3
    w = state.setdefault('macq_w', [0, 0, 0, 0])
    accq = state.setdefault('macq_acc', [0, 0, 0, 0])
    if f3 == 0x1:
        w[g] = rs1 & 0xFFFFFFFF
        state['macq_w'] = w
        return 0, state
    if f3 == 0x2:
        v = accq[g]
        accq[g] = 0
        state['macq_acc'] = accq
        return v, state
    # MACQ
    acts = []
    for i in range(4):
        a = (rs1 >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF
        acts.append(a - 256 if a & 0x80 else a)
    for gg in range(4):
        s = 0
        for i in range(4):
            b = (w[gg] >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF
            if b & 0x80:
                b -= 256
            s += acts[i] * b
        accq[gg] = (accq[gg] + s) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    state['macq_acc'] = accq
    return accq[0], state

encoding.funct3: 0x3 (XMV: chuyen giua x1-x31 va bang mo rong)
encoding.funct7: bit[4:0] = chi so o trong bang mo rong (0..31); bit[5] = huong (0: x -> bang, 1: bang -> x); bit[6] = 0

spec.semantics_python:
def sem(rs1, rs2, state):
    # custom-1, funct3=0x3 : XMV
    #   huong 0 (x -> bang):  xr[i] = rs1 ; rd = x0 (khong ghi)
    #   huong 1 (bang -> x):  rd = xr[i]
    f7 = state.get('imm_acc', 0)
    i = f7 & 0x1F
    to_x = (f7 >> 5) & 1
    xr = state.setdefault('xr', [0] * 32)
    if to_x:
        return xr[i] & 0xFFFFFFFF, state
    xr[i] = rs1 & 0xFFFFFFFF
    state['xr'] = xr
    return 0, state
